local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

-- Currency maths.
local Economy = {}
function Economy.cost(base, level) return base * level end
function Economy.sell(v) return v end
function Economy.refund(v) return v / 2 end
return Economy

-- Server entry point: starts every service.
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local DataService = require(script.Parent.Services.DataService)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.Services.ShopService)
local MiningService = require(script.Parent.Services.MiningService)
local SellService = require(script.Parent.Services.SellService)
local UpgradeService = require(script.Parent.Services.UpgradeService)
local RebirthService = require(script.Parent.Services.RebirthService)
local LeaderboardService = require(script.Parent.Services.LeaderboardService)

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Util = require(RS.Modules.Util)
local Config = require(RS.Modules.Config)
-- Saves and loads player data.
local DSS = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local store = DSS:GetDataStore("PlayerData")
local D = {}
function D.load(player) return store:GetAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId) end
function D.save(player, data) store:UpdateAsync("Player_" .. player.UserId, function() return data end) end
return D

local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes")
local ShopData = require(RS.Modules.ShopData)
local Economy = require(RS.Modules.Economy)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
-- Sells items to players.
local Shop = {}
local Cash = Remotes:WaitForChild("UpdateCash")
local Stock = Remotes:WaitForChild("GetStock")
Stock.OnServerInvoke = function(player) return ShopData.Items end
function Shop.purchase(player, item)
	Cash:FireClient(player, Economy.cost(1, 1))
end
return Shop

-- Upgrades and equips tools.

local Up = Remotes:WaitForChild("UpgradeTool")
function U.upgrade(player) local tool = game:GetService("StarterPack"):FindFirstChild("Drill") Up:FireClient(player, ToolStats.Levels) end
return U
